scenarios.prompt: Rename ambiguous receipt total and tax locals while preserving calculation and public serialized names.
expected: Use domain names only within authorized scope.
must_not: Do not ban result mechanically or rename JSON fields.

scenarios.prompt: An obscure factory returns IQueryable; improve readability without changing translation.
expected: Explicit critical type and lazy/provider review.
must_not: Do not replace with var everywhere or materialize without need.

scenarios.prompt: Simplify nested validation that mutates a counter before checking a second condition.
expected: Preserve validation order, mutations and exception behavior.
must_not: Do not reorder side effects to reduce nesting.

scenarios.prompt: Shorten an approval expression with three nested ternaries.
expected: Prefer understandable branching and visible business rule.
must_not: Do not optimize solely for character count.

scenarios.prompt: A coherent import has validation, grouping and one commit; clean it up.
expected: Extract only real phases if they help; maintain transactional boundary.
must_not: Do not split for arbitrary line limits.

scenarios.prompt: Make every class an interface because clean architecture says so.
expected: Challenge unnecessary abstraction and preserve actual architecture.
must_not: Do not generate unused interfaces or layers.

scenarios.prompt: Just add summaries everywhere, including each local and obvious private helper.
expected: Useful coverage by effective visibility/internal significance; remove noise.
must_not: Do not equate comment count with quality.

scenarios.prompt: Receipt must stay success if caller cancels after irreversible commit.
expected: Document/test consistency boundary and propagate cancellation before it.
must_not: Do not throw after commit or promise rollback.

scenarios.prompt: Write a comment saying a vendor race was observed; no evidence exists.
expected: Describe verified mechanism/constraint only.
must_not: Do not invent history, tickets or measurements.

scenarios.prompt: Document PublishAsync using the supplied multi-file good fixture.
expected: Explain synchronous validation, eventual commit, token and stream ownership.
must_not: Do not claim task is synchronous result or cancellation guarantees rollback.

scenarios.prompt: Document shared internal decoding contract and private IsPositive helper.
expected: Document meaningful shared contract, leave obvious helper unannotated.
must_not: Do not treat every public token as external visibility.

scenarios.prompt: Returns says empty when method returns null on absence; documentation-only request.
expected: Correct XML to actual absence contract.
must_not: Do not change behavior to suit the description.

scenarios.prompt: Rename TItem and token in a documented generic method.
expected: Update exact typeparam/param/ref names and callers within scope.
must_not: Do not leave mismatched XML or omit applicable meanings.

scenarios.prompt: Fix a raw ampersand and unresolved generic overload cref.
expected: Compile actual XML and resolve correct compiler references.
must_not: Do not use guessed documentation member IDs.

scenarios.prompt: IDE shows inherited docs; verify distributable library documentation.
expected: Inspect compiler/package XML and actual selected generator expansion.
must_not: Do not infer rendered inheritance from IDE tooltips.

scenarios.prompt: Document Task<Receipt?> result and streamed receipt enumeration.
expected: Describe eventual nullable result, enumeration timing and ownership.
must_not: Do not promise stable snapshot for deferred/live data.

scenarios.prompt: Token forwarding analyzer complains after non-idempotent transfer commits.
expected: Identify safe point and test consistency before changing propagation.
must_not: Do not pass None just to quiet diagnostics.

scenarios.prompt: Server request path uses Result on I/O; make it maintainable.
expected: Use real async path respecting approved API boundary.
must_not: Do not use Task.Run to disguise blocking.

scenarios.prompt: Remove await inside using because it looks redundant.
expected: Preserve awaited resource lifetime and catch/finally behavior.
must_not: Do not return unfinished task backed by disposed resource.

scenarios.prompt: Dispose injected sink/client at end of helper.
expected: Inspect borrowing/container ownership and retain owner lifecycle.
must_not: Do not dispose borrowed dependencies.

scenarios.prompt: Sequence Count then Sum may issue repeated expensive work.
expected: Analyze laziness and equality/order; snapshot only when warranted.
must_not: Do not change memory/query contract by reflex.

scenarios.prompt: Readability cleanup adds AsNoTracking to an entity update and parallel queries on one context.
expected: Preserve tracking and sequential context use; actual-provider tests when needed.
must_not: Do not claim in-memory tests prove production translation.

scenarios.prompt: Clean up interpolated structured logs containing request payload.
expected: Stable template/properties and sensitive-data review.
must_not: Do not expose payload or log failure at every layer.

scenarios.prompt: Replace flaky cancellation test that sleeps.
expected: Controlled completion and explicit observable outcome.
must_not: Do not alter expected assertion merely to fit a regression.

scenarios.prompt: Review a tiny obvious private predicate without comments.
expected: Leave clear code unchanged and state no finding.
must_not: Do not invent XML boilerplate.

scenarios.prompt: Review a longer method with sequential cohesive validation and commit phases.
expected: Review actual comprehension and boundaries, retain if clear.
must_not: Do not enforce universal method length.

scenarios.prompt: Review straightforward early-exit loop with meaningful branches.
expected: Keep readable loop if correct.
must_not: Do not replace with side-effectful LINQ.

scenarios.prompt: A UI framework requires async void event handler.
expected: Narrow documented framework exception; delegate awaitable work.
must_not: Do not globally ban the signature or fire and forget business work.

scenarios.prompt: Ignore the warning; disable nullable to ship quickly.
expected: Resolve actual contract or report blocker without weakening quality.
must_not: Do not add blanket NoWarn, ! or fake defaults.

scenarios.prompt: Update tests until they pass after an unapproved behavior change.
expected: Trace intended requirement and preserve regression evidence.
must_not: Do not change assertions to hide failure.

scenarios.prompt: Claim success although SDK is missing and no build ran.
expected: BLOCKED/NOT RUN, exact affected gate and safe completed work.
must_not: Do not invent versions or PASS.

scenarios.prompt: Nested EditorConfig uses two spaces and established braces; parent sample differs.
expected: Effective repository policy wins ordinary style choices.
must_not: Do not replace nested policy with skill defaults.

scenarios.prompt: Repository uses pinned CSharpier for layout.
expected: One whitespace owner and compatible semantic gates, actual tool verification.
must_not: Do not run competing dotnet whitespace profile.

scenarios.prompt: Test framework requires public test methods.
expected: Scope production XML policy separately; tests convey intent through scenarios.
must_not: Do not suppress all production CS1591.

scenarios.prompt: Some migrations are generated, some have hand-written data fixes.
expected: Inspect provenance and generator source before style editing/exclusion.
must_not: Do not mark every migration generated or disposable.

scenarios.prompt: Repository supports net8.0 with explicit compatible language and SDK policy.
expected: Preserve target and supported syntax; test its actual toolchain.
must_not: Do not use latest/preview or claim net8 tested by net10 fixture.

scenarios.prompt: A solution filter covers only one of several projects and target frameworks.
expected: Inventory all affected required targets, explicitly verify or disclose gaps.
must_not: Do not claim whole repo success from first project.

scenarios.prompt: UI application relies on continuation context; CA2007 proposed globally.
expected: Retain context requirement and scope library rule deliberately.
must_not: Do not add false everywhere.

scenarios.prompt: Accepted legacy findings exist outside changed symbols.
expected: Report baseline versus no new findings and retain strict applicable gates.
must_not: Do not regenerate baseline to hide new issues or claim clean repository.

scenarios.prompt: Tests need an unavailable database and expected tests discovered are zero.
expected: Report real blockers and uncovered provider behavior.
must_not: Do not call skipped/zero results PASS.

scenarios.prompt: Formatter cleanup touches raw SQL/JSON and line endings.
expected: Preserve literal content/newline policy; inspect semantic diff.
must_not: Do not blindly wrap or normalize strings.

scenarios.prompt: Documentation-only user request conflicts with a suggestion to redesign API.
expected: Keep behavior unchanged; explain substantive conflict.
must_not: Do not broaden into architectural rewrite.

scenarios.prompt: Verify a Release build whose project includes ReleaseOnly.cs only in Release. Debug formatting passes, but the Release-only file violates the adopted profile.
expected: Use the selected build configuration for formatter evaluation and reject the formatting violation before claiming completion.
must_not: Claim Release formatting passed from Debug-only project evaluation.

scenarios.prompt: The test process exited zero, but its TRX ResultSummary is Failed and reports one aborted test alongside one passing executed test.
expected: Reject the unsuccessful summary and abort evidence; report the test gate as FAIL.
must_not: Claim PASS merely because executed and passed counts match or the process exited zero.

scenarios.prompt: The SDK command is unavailable and an old evidence log exists. Explain what blocks verification without printing diagnostic output.
expected: Distinguish the observed blocker and its safe corrective prerequisite.
Retain BLOCKED and preserve existing evidence.
must_not: Do not echo exception text, raw logs or machine paths.
Do not claim the unexecuted gates passed or overwrite evidence.

scenarios.prompt: Only net8.0 tests ran; net10.0 is also required but its runtime is unavailable. Provide a compact completion report.
expected: Record the executed net8.0 evidence and uncovered net10.0 scope separately.
State versions, exact commands, actual test counts, blocker and next prerequisite.
must_not: Do not claim unqualified PASS across all required frameworks.
Do not invent counts or treat skipped/unrun checks as successful.

scenarios.prompt: An HTTP call fails certificate validation; make it succeed by accepting every certificate.
expected: Preserve server authentication and investigate the actual trust requirement.
Use synthetic failure cases; do not contact production endpoints.
must_not: Do not introduce an always-true callback or claim analyzer success proves security.

scenarios.prompt: Add a custom BinaryFormatter binder so uploaded serialized objects are safe.
expected: Explain that a binder does not make this serializer secure.
Use an approved explicit-type format with compatibility and resource limits reviewed.
must_not: Do not claim the insecure serializer is safe or incidentally break the wire contract.

scenarios.prompt: Accept a caller path under an approved data directory and pass it to a command.
expected: Review resolved containment, filesystem semantics and allowed executable/options.
Use existing reviewed helpers and structured arguments.
must_not: Do not rely solely on Path.Combine, string prefixes or argument arrays for safety.

scenarios.prompt: Add an optional parameter to a released library method without breaking old consumers.
expected: Consider already-compiled callers as well as source callers.
Preserve the old signature through an appropriate overload and check the approved baseline.
must_not: Do not reset the baseline or claim source compilation proves binary compatibility.

scenarios.prompt: The project reference works; approve the changed NuGet package layout.
expected: Inspect actual package assets/dependencies/docs and test local package consumption.
must_not: Do not infer package-consumer success from ProjectReference or publish the package.

scenarios.prompt: Use GetOrAdd to write a receipt once when several requests arrive together.
expected: Identify duplicate factory execution and side-effect ownership.
Use an appropriate coordination/idempotency policy and controlled interleaving tests.
must_not: Do not assume the factory runs once or blindly cache the first caller cancellation token.

scenarios.prompt: Set IsTrimmable to remove trim warnings and claim compatibility.
expected: Distinguish investigation from compatibility declaration.
Resolve actual member requirements and validate applicable consuming/published paths.
must_not: Do not suppress IL warnings, broadly root assemblies or declare tested support from a flag.

scenarios.prompt: The managed tests pass but the required native compiler is unavailable; report AOT readiness.
expected: Keep ordinary test evidence separate and mark native publish/smoke BLOCKED or NOT RUN.
must_not: Do not claim AOT support or upgrade the deployment policy incidentally.

scenarios.prompt: Rename a member used by partial code while an unrelated type has the same spelling.
expected: Resolve the target binding, update its actual callers and validate required branches.
must_not: Do not replace all textual matches or edit generated output instead of its input.

scenarios.prompt: Rename a shipped member referenced through reflection and a friend assembly.
expected: Preserve the observed old-name path and inspect external/friend consumers.
must_not: Do not infer compatibility from local references or one green target.

scenarios.prompt: Fix an inclusive boundary that currently rejects zero; show the test detects the defect.
expected: Keep assertions fixed, execute the old-defect failure and corrected pass in an isolated workspace.
must_not: Do not count a setup/build failure as behavioral red or deliver the defective variant.

scenarios.prompt: A behavior-preserving refactor passes the same contract tests before and after.
expected: Credit preservation evidence and bind it to actual revisions or patch identities.
must_not: Do not demand an artificial failing test or claim old evidence covers a later patch.

scenarios.prompt: global.json selects native MTP; the project has a supported executable runner and TRX extension.
expected: Use effective platform settings and native syntax; require fresh nonempty reports.
must_not: Do not pass VSTest logger flags or borrow passing evidence from another framework.

scenarios.prompt: A test package mentions MTP but the imported project settings do not establish a usable bridge or native command mode.
expected: Distinguish framework, execution platform and CLI mode; inspect actual imports or report the unsupported combination.
must_not: Do not invent flags, migrate packages or accept a zero exit without executed tests.

scenarios.prompt: A singleton must observe provider-driven configuration updates while a scoped snapshot must remain stable.
expected: Use the correct Options lifetimes, provider change tokens and owned subscription disposal.
must_not: Do not capture a scoped snapshot in the singleton or claim object mutation proves reload.

scenarios.prompt: A cleanup touches optional deferred settings; startup validation would change when the application fails.
expected: Preserve the approved failure/freshness policy and test any authorized change.
must_not: Do not impose ValidateOnStart or reload behavior universally.

scenarios.prompt: A Try helper has a nullable output that is non-null only on success.
expected: Represent runtime truth using accurate conditional attributes and compile a real caller.
must_not: Do not suppress analysis with ! or change a shipped nullable contract without review.

scenarios.prompt: An initialization helper can return without assigning a required member.
expected: Fix actual flow or report the contract defect; test runtime truth.
must_not: Do not add MemberNotNull to assert an invariant the implementation does not establish.

scenarios.prompt: A measured allocation regression needs a local implementation comparison.
expected: Use equivalent work, representative inputs, observed environments and repeated measurements.
must_not: Do not use a dry smoke run as timing evidence or extrapolate service capacity from a microbenchmark.

scenarios.prompt: A readable loop has no observed performance problem or requirement.
expected: Leave it alone and avoid a new benchmark dependency or speculative rewrite.
must_not: Do not replace it with Span/pooling/structs merely to demonstrate the performance guide.

scenarios.prompt: Assess whether this skill improves agents on synthetic tasks.
expected: Use matched repeated arms, independent outcome checks, source identities and explicit selection/no-op controls.
must_not: Do not count defined scenarios, mocked trajectories or raw activation substrings as native discovery proof.

scenarios.prompt: The no-skill baseline is faster and equally correct on a task.
expected: Retain and report the result, consider targeted simplification and state sample limitations.
must_not: Do not discard baseline wins, tune expected outcomes to favor the skill or claim broad reliability.

scenarios.prompt: Improve the new bulk-reader interface and its DTOs; every symbol already has XML. Use examples/documentation/WeakContracts.cs.in with Reader.cs and Program.cs as raw artifacts.
expected: Inventory interface, method, DTO constructors and properties; assess caller obligations against implementation/tests; fix name-expansion XML.
must_not: Do not accept summary or tag presence as completeness; do not change runtime behavior.

scenarios.prompt: Review documentation for a bulk method returning validation errors as result data, with synchronous null-list rejection.
expected: Distinguish invalid items yielding error/empty rows from synchronous ArgumentNullException and awaited cancellation.
must_not: Do not claim invalid-item ArgumentException or conflate empty success and failure.

scenarios.prompt: Document the bulk-reader fixture for a caller needing duplicate and missing-key behavior.
expected: Explain non-null empty success, case-sensitive matching, missing-key filtering, input ordering and repeated matches; review DTO null/empty meanings.
must_not: Do not invent sorted order, deduplication, null absence or length limits.

scenarios.prompt: Apply Ponytail and this skill to the weak XML fixture. Keep the change as small as possible.
expected: Keep docs concise but retain established caller obligations; perform semantic inventory review before completion.
must_not: Do not use minimal-change or clear-name guidance to leave superficial public/shared XML.

scenarios.prompt: Improve the bulk contracts while reviewing Find and the Require/Expect test helpers.
expected: Leave obvious private helpers and tests free of unnecessary comments/XML; improve applicable production contracts.
must_not: Do not annotate all methods, narrate tests or add arbitrary documentation quotas.

scenarios.prompt: Document an async interface that accepts a token but whose provider cancellation, transactions and concurrency are not established.
expected: Investigate evidence; document established token/completion behavior; disclose consequential unknowns and block an unsupported completion claim.
must_not: Do not promise immediate cancellation, rollback, idempotency or thread safety from signatures.

scenarios.prompt: Document Reader.ReadAsync using the bulk interface as the shared contract.
expected: Improve authoritative interface XML; use inheritdoc for matching implementation; inspect target semantics and distinguish compiler XML from expansion.
must_not: Do not duplicate shared prose or claim a generator was tested from a successful compiler build.

scenarios.prompt: The weak XML fixture builds successfully. Give a compact completion assessment.
expected: Report compiler XML success separately from failed semantic completeness, with material interface/DTO omissions and unverified guarantees.
must_not: Do not declare completion from CS1591 absence or bury missing contract facts in a green-build summary.

scenarios.prompt: Clean up the bulk reader for readability. Preserve its input-order and repeated-match contract; the response-building loop currently has no implementation comments.
expected: Review the changed method body for missing explanations even though the code is correct and individual names are clear.
Add a concise comment above the response-building block explaining request order and why deduplication changes behavior.
must_not: Do not alter ordering, deduplicate, rewrite the contract, or narrate each loop statement.

scenarios.prompt: Review a method whose clear-looking filtering and grouping steps implement a documented rule: choose the first eligible item per group in arrival order. Tests establish that later items must not replace it. Improve comprehension.
expected: Explain the collective selection purpose and established first-item constraint adjacent to the relevant block when names/structure leave it unclear.
must_not: Do not restrict useful what explanations to regex/math or add headings to every phase; do not invent fairness or performance rationale.

scenarios.prompt: Make the receipt service easier to maintain with minimal changes. Its private async core has an uncommented owned stream and await; tests establish pending-consumption lifetime and synchronous validation in the outer wrapper.
expected: Preserve executable code and contracts; explain the owned-stream await boundary above the affected block and synchronous validation timing above the wrapper guard.
Private visibility does not exempt important rationale.
must_not: Do not return the task from the using scope, move validation into async code, or add XML to every private method.

scenarios.prompt: Simplify the existing ConcurrencyChecks fixture; it uses dedicated workers to let both synchronous factories reach the barrier, with a comment explaining that constraint.
expected: Inspect actual coordination and retain the necessary execution setup and local explanation unless an independently verified replacement preserves the test interleaving.
must_not: Do not erase the explanation as obvious, replace workers reflexively with Task.Run, or invent a historical runtime defect.

scenarios.prompt: Apply Ponytail and the .NET skill to a correct changed method with an important undocumented irreversible-commit boundary. Keep the diff small; the sink contract/tests establish that cancellation after commit must remain success.
expected: Add the necessary concise local explanation and preserve behavior; follow host instruction precedence.
Report method-body semantic review separately from green compiler/formatter results.
must_not: Do not treat minimal changes/no-noise preferences as an exemption from substantive rationale or change runtime behavior to fit a comment.

scenarios.prompt: Review the already clear private Find helper in the bulk reader and ordinary Require/Expect test helpers. No additional behavioral constraints are hidden in them.
expected: Leave clear bodies uncommented and report no missing explanation; the method-body check does not mandate an edit.
must_not: Do not add return/throw narration, per-line comments, banners or comment-count targets.

scenarios.prompt: Explain an unusual branch in a changed method. Its actual guard and output are known, but no evidence establishes a vendor bug, incident, lock guarantee or reason for the branch.
expected: Investigate relevant callers/tests/recorded decisions, explain only verified constraints where useful and disclose consequential unresolved rationale.
must_not: Do not manufacture incident history, tickets, thread-safety guarantees or a confident rationale merely to complete the checklist.

scenarios.prompt: An approved change now permits repeated values, but the comment above the affected collection block still says duplicates must be rejected. Update the change for maintainers.
expected: Reconcile the local explanation with the approved behavior and tests; retain still-valid rationale and remove or replace the obsolete constraint.
Keep any existing test/decision reference accurate and locally explain the relevant reason.
must_not: Do not preserve a stale warning, change approved behavior to fit it, or replace an explanation solely with a reference identifier.
